sources.entry: vizologi.com - Offers a unique blend of business model canvassing and AI-driven market analysis.

summary.name: Vizologi
summary.one_liner: Vizologi is an AI-powered business planning platform for generating ideas, analyzing markets and competitors, and building business plans and strategy decks.
use_cases: Combining business models into new strategies
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI platform that connects brainstorming, business intelligence, and planning in one workflow. It claims to generate ideas with unique names, produce automated competitor intelligence reports, and analyze target markets using data and analytics. It says users can build business plans using a mash-up innovation methodology, combine data from companies, and export presentations. The page also states it offers continuously updated industry insights. Specific feature details and methodology are not explained beyond these claims.
notable: Mash-up innovation methodology for combining business models
Monthly and yearly subscription options with a yearly discount
caveats: Page says it is free to get started but paid tiers (monthly and yearly plans) are shown
Claims such as 25+ thousand projects and $75 return per $1 are unverified marketing statements
Platform availability beyond the web is not stated
